verdict.rationale: Vanta clearly runs work autonomously in the background: continuous automated tests and evidence collection from integrations (vanta-docs-10, vanta-docs-45, vanta-docs-16), an AI Agent that works across the platform to draft policies and flag issues (vanta-docs-15), a TPRM Agent that discovers and monitors vendors (vanta-docs-13), and automated reminders and workflows (vanta-docs-22). User-defined automation is thinner and mostly developer-built: Custom Tests fed by pushed data (vanta-docs-2), webhooks (vanta-docs-4), and API-driven bulk actions (vanta-docs-23). missing for 10: a user-configurable automation/trigger builder or scheduling of custom agent tasks, documentation on how users set up and govern background agent runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
